claim: Patchline ships an automated theorem-discovery loop proposing and proving new safety lemmas. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the theorem-discovery claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make theorem-discovery-loop-gate`.
